instana_ApplicationService.label.justification: Both serve as names or labels for identification purposes.
Service labels can be seen as analogous to usernames, both being forms of identifiers.

instana_ServiceEndpoint.label.justification: Both are used for naming or labeling purposes, one for service endpoints and the other for display names.

instana_ServiceEndpoint.id.justification: Both are unique identifiers, one for a service endpoint and the other for a Concert instance.

instana_ApplicationService.id.justification: Both are unique identifiers, one for a service and the other for a Concert instance.

instana_ApplicationService.types.justification: Types of services can be analogous to user roles, both defining categories or functionalities within their respective systems.
